targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(loc_added_sum) AS 'LOC Accepted'
FROM _tool_copilot_user_daily_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(day)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.loc_added_sum) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id), 0), 1) AS 'LOC Accepted / PR'
FROM _tool_copilot_user_daily_metrics r
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT id FROM pull_requests
  WHERE merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(merged_date)
) pr
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.day)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.loc_added_sum) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cdc.cicd_deployment_id), 0), 1) AS 'LOC Accepted / Deploy'
FROM _tool_copilot_user_daily_metrics r
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT cicd_deployment_id
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits
  WHERE result = 'SUCCESS' AND environment = 'PRODUCTION'
    AND $__timeFilter(finished_date)
) cdc
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.day)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.loc_added_sum) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT i.id), 0), 1) AS 'LOC Accepted / Issue'
FROM _tool_copilot_user_daily_metrics r
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT id FROM issues
  WHERE resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND type != 'INCIDENT'
    AND $__timeFilter(resolution_date)
) i
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.day)

panels.description: Weekly Copilot LOC accepted per merged PR

targets.rawSql:
WITH _loc AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(day), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(day)) DAY) AS week_start,
    SUM(loc_added_sum) AS loc
  FROM _tool_copilot_user_daily_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
  GROUP BY DATE_SUB(DATE(day), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(day)) DAY)
),
_prs AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(merged_date)) DAY) AS week_start,
    COUNT(*) AS prs
  FROM pull_requests
  WHERE merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(merged_date)
  GROUP BY DATE_SUB(DATE(merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(merged_date)) DAY)
)
SELECT l.week_start AS time,
  ROUND(l.loc / NULLIF(p.prs, 0), 1) AS 'LOC Accepted per PR'
FROM _loc l
LEFT JOIN _prs p ON l.week_start = p.week_start
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Weekly Copilot LOC accepted per production deployment

targets.rawSql:
WITH _loc AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(day), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(day)) DAY) AS week_start,
    SUM(loc_added_sum) AS loc
  FROM _tool_copilot_user_daily_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
  GROUP BY DATE_SUB(DATE(day), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(day)) DAY)
),
_deploys AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(finished_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(finished_date)) DAY) AS week_start,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cicd_deployment_id) AS deploys
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits
  WHERE result = 'SUCCESS' AND environment = 'PRODUCTION'
    AND $__timeFilter(finished_date)
  GROUP BY DATE_SUB(DATE(finished_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(finished_date)) DAY)
)
SELECT l.week_start AS time,
  ROUND(l.loc / NULLIF(d.deploys, 0), 1) AS 'LOC Accepted per Deploy'
FROM _loc l
LEFT JOIN _deploys d ON l.week_start = d.week_start
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Weekly Copilot LOC accepted per resolved issue

targets.rawSql:
WITH _loc AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(day), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(day)) DAY) AS week_start,
    SUM(loc_added_sum) AS loc
  FROM _tool_copilot_user_daily_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
  GROUP BY DATE_SUB(DATE(day), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(day)) DAY)
),
_issues AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(resolution_date)) DAY) AS week_start,
    COUNT(*) AS resolved
  FROM issues
  WHERE resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND type != 'INCIDENT'
    AND $__timeFilter(resolution_date)
  GROUP BY DATE_SUB(DATE(resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(resolution_date)) DAY)
)
SELECT l.week_start AS time,
  ROUND(l.loc / NULLIF(i.resolved, 0), 1) AS 'LOC Accepted per Issue'
FROM _loc l
LEFT JOIN _issues i ON l.week_start = i.week_start
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Is Copilot usage growing over time?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE_SUB(DATE(day), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(day)) DAY) AS time,
  SUM(loc_suggested_to_add_sum) AS 'LOC Suggested',
  SUM(loc_added_sum) AS 'LOC Accepted',
  SUM(user_initiated_interaction_count) AS 'Interactions',
  SUM(code_generation_activity_count) AS 'Code Generations'
FROM _tool_copilot_user_daily_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
GROUP BY DATE_SUB(DATE(day), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE(day)) DAY)
ORDER BY time
